# Pathum Dilshan

> Pathum Dilshan is an RF and network planning engineer at Mobitel (Sri Lanka) who builds data engineering and machine learning tools for mobile network KPIs. He holds a BSc (Hons) in Electronic & Telecommunication Engineering (CINEC Campus) and is reading for an MSc in Data Science & AI at the University of Moratuwa.

Not to be confused with Pathum Dilshan, the Sri Lankan cricketer.

## Key facts
- Current role: Engineer – Network Planning & Optimization, Mobitel (Pvt) Ltd, Colombo (since Sep 2024)
- Previous: Technical Executive (Huawei), Prime Engineering Lanka, deployed to Hutchison Telecommunications Lanka (2024)
- Research: drift-aware anomaly detection and root-cause ranking for mobile RAN KPI data (supervisor Prof. Indika Perera)
- Skills: RF/RAN optimization, LTE/5G, Python, SQL, Apache Airflow, machine learning, anomaly detection, Power BI, Looker Studio
- Contact: pmpdilshan@gmail.com
